criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Raw Purdue GIS OBJECTID=216 names 'Grant Street Parking Garage', ABBR=PGG, address=120 N. Grant Street; the saved foundation ring matches the independently projected source polygon with max nearest-vertex error 0.000020 m (mean 0.000010 m, 30 vertices).

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: GIS polygon and mesh are in campus coordinates; bounds (296.3609796081398, 371.74638646338934, -292.5725223306699, -190.73364834431231); source-derived XY envelope 75.385 x 101.839 m, evaluated full asset dimensions 75.385 x 102.029 x 16.985 m. Plan orientation follows ordered GIS polygon edges. Comparison uses the same GIS feature that generated the footprint, so it verifies implementation fidelity, not independent survey accuracy.
criteria.status: source geometry reproduced; absolute survey accuracy unverified

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The saved mesh contains 5 named upper deck polygons and a flat parking roof. The ARSEE source photo visibly supports a multi-level open parking deck and rooftop parking. Modeled total vertical extent is 16.99 m; neither the photo nor cited road-school clearance supplies a full building height or surveyed floor elevations. The recorded 3.18 m level intervals and 16.83 m top are therefore estimates, not verified measurements.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Direct comparison of the ARSEE project photo with the saved three-quarter and south-façade renders confirms red-brown brick piers/cores, pale horizontal floor bands, open parking bays, stair/elevator glazing, and an entry feature are represented. The model simplifies the photo's arched precast/spandrel openings and brick core/entry shapes; entrance orientation is explicitly inferred.
criteria.status: major visual features represented with simplifications

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Loaded file matches expected path: True; exported collection 'Asset_massing_grant_street_parking_garage_pgg_f46c894' contains 13 objects (12 mesh objects); no unpacked external images/textures detected (0 paths). Evidence record and all three render files exist: {'pgg_three_quarter.png': True, 'pgg_topdown.png': True, 'pgg_south_facade.png': True}.

findings: Footprint geometry is a near-exact reproduction of the identified Purdue GIS polygon, but that polygon is not a wall survey and the project’s local geographic approximation is not a surveyed CRS.
No cited source establishes the garage’s full measured height or floor elevations; retain the model height and 3.18 m intervals as estimates.

The undated project photo supports the architectural family, but the current render simplifies the prominent arched floor openings and entrance/core geometry; improve these if closer visual fidelity is required.
